newsitem.title: UK: Labour says polls show no room for complacency.
newsitem.headline: Labour says polls show no room for complacency.

text.p: The latest opinion poll in the British election race showing the Labour party's lead has fallen to 14 points underscores the party's need to avoid complacency, Labour economics spokesman Gordon Brown said on Wednesday.
"The most recent opinion poll means that we will never be complacent. We will take nothing for granted and we will take no voter for granted," Brown told a news conference.

The poll in The Guardian newspaper showed Labour on 46 percent against 32 percent for the Conservatives and 17 percent for the minority Liberal Democrats. The previous Guardian poll in March gave Labour an 18-point lead.
